decisions.question: Which of the 35 proposals go into the starter?

options.label: All 35
options.summary: Rules, components, tokens, words, plugin fixes and guard templates.

options.label: Only those approved in a version
options.summary: Drops R14 and C3, which come from owner decisions not yet in a numbered version.

options.label: Starter content only
options.summary: Rules, components, tokens and words now; plugin fixes and guards later.

decisions.question: What about Project A's draft items (card frame, two-level section header, settings that save by themselves)?

options.label: Wait for its approval
options.summary: Add them in a later round once Project A approves its next version.

options.label: Add now
options.summary: Add them as starter items to keep, change or delete.

decisions.question: How should DS4 (stale gallery) behave on branches?

options.label: Rebuild at join and promote
options.summary: Branches may leave the draft gallery stale; the join and promote rebuild it; DS4 only warns on the default branch.

options.label: Keep the warning
options.summary: Every branch rebuilds the gallery itself.

options.label: Information only
options.summary: DS4 becomes a note for next-version and stays a warning for the current version.

decisions.question: May a frozen version take link-only edits after files move?

options.label: Yes, link targets only
options.summary: Allowed when every change is a link target that points at an existing file; the check proves it and the digest is taken again.

options.label: No, stay strict
options.summary: A move leaves old links in frozen versions.

decisions.question: Should the starter ask for 7:1 contrast for body text in the dark theme?

options.label: Keep AA, mention 7:1
options.summary: WCAG 2.2 AA stays the rule; tokens.md names 7:1 as a choice.

options.label: Require 7:1 in dark
options.summary: Body text and status text on tint reach 7:1 in the dark theme.

options.label: After DS189 and DSY99
options.summary: Tasks 1 and 2 after DS189 merges; tasks 3 and 4 after DSY99 merges.

options.label: Start tasks 3 and 4 now
options.summary: Take over the kit folder from main without waiting for DSY99.
